# Template:Taglink

<div class="mw-parser-output">

A template to simplify cross-referencing definition [tags](/templates/tag) (currently only within a page).

Usage:

    &#123;&#123;taglink|foo&#125;&#125;

Result:

[foo](#foo)

Usage (Optional 2nd param to link to a tag with a given value):

    &#123;&#123;taglink|foo|bar&#125;&#125;

Result: [foo](#foo) = bar

N.B. Please do not use this tag *within* a \<code\> block when documenting a formula tags are used in - it will break the markup and is confusing. See [Gamedev:WeaponDefs#Tag:burstRate](/gamedev-weapondefs#tagburstrate) for an example of the proper usage in this case.

</div>
